title: WorldDiff
description: The engine-owned inverse patch. It is the single source of truth for build-level undo (BUILD_ENGINE_PLAN.md section 7.4); FAWE is only the write mechanism. A WorldDiff records, for every cell a commit overwrote, the exact before/after block state so the commit can be applied (redo) or reverted (undo) exactly, even if surrounding terrain changed.

BlockChange.title: BlockChange
BlockChange.description: A single cell's transition. 'before' is what the world held prior to the commit (used for undo); 'after' is what the commit wrote (used for redo).

id.description: Stable id for this diff; passed to undoDiff.
